Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.About UsThe Hannover Medical School (MHH), with about 10,000 employees the biggest company of Lower Saxony, is a university institution for research and teaching in the human and dental medicine and a university hospital of supra-maximum medical care. Research, teaching, medical care and administration work hand in hand in the integration model at the MHH-campus.The Peter L. Reichertz Institute for Medical Informatics (PLRI) is one of the largest university centres for medical informatics in Germany. It belongs to two leading universities, is situated in one of Europe's most research-intensive regions, and offers excellent opportunities for research. In interdisciplinary projects, the PLRI collaborates with health centres, research institutes, corporations, and public institutions in order to shape the future of the health system and medicine. The activities range from diverse topics on the local level, to regional, national, and global collaborations.The research group "Clinical Data Science" focuses on the detection of novel routine clinical and -omics biomarkers for disease diagnosis and prognosis to personalize and thus improve patient treatment. To achieve this, we integrate phenotypical information and routine clinical as well as (multi)-omics data by high-dimensional statistics and state-of-the-art artificial intelligence to gain novel insights into underlying disease pathomechanisms. Moreover, we are interested in developing and implementing research data platforms for complex (multi-)omics data. The project "MALDIDive: Enabling AI Research with Public MALDI-TOF Fingerprints across Microbial Diversity", to be carried out within an interdisciplinary research team and funded by the German Research Foundation, will establish a well curated data platform of MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry datasets from the Leibniz Institute German Collection of Mircoorganisms and Cell Cultures GmbH (DSMZ). We are looking for an enthusiastic PostDoc who is interested in omics data platform development and deployment for future AI use.Your Responsibilities- data platform architecture, backend, and frontend development as well as deployment for MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry database/platform and associated metadata- development of interactive data visualization concepts and their implementation into data platform- development and realization of short explanatory videos for platform users- co-organization and co-leading of stakeholder workshops to define user requirements and conduct user test cycles- presentation to the scientific community, i.e., by publishing in high-level journals and via presentations at international conferences- close collaboration with interdisciplinary project partners from AI / data science, analytical, and micro­biological research communities, particularly the DSMZ- bachelor / master student co-supervisionYour Profile- PhD / Dr. rer. nat. / Dr.-Ing. degree in data science / bioinformatics / computational biology / informatics / physics or similar research fields- expertise in the work on databases, interactive platform development, -omics and biomedical data, and / or artificial intelligence / machine learning- proficiency in backend / frontend development and / or database programming, including one or more of the following programming languages: VueJS, TypeScript, SQL, PYTHON, R Shiny, nginx, Docker, etc.- proficiency in English (written and oral)- desired: experience with code documentary systems and RestAPI- desired: knowledge of the German languageWe offer- a full-time position initially limited to two years with 38.5 hours per week at one of the largest employers in the state of Lower Saxony- depending on your individual qualifications, a salary according to TV-L salary group E13 is possible, with the benefits associated with public sector employment (e.g. occupational pension scheme and supplementary insurance through VBL)- an exciting role at the interface of research, healthcare and science management- a supportive induction process within a motivated and interdisciplinary team- support to pursue postdoctoral career (e.g., mentoring programs, etc.)- working in a highly motivated and cooperative research team of scientists- excellent perspectives for your scientific career development and networking- individual training and further education opportunities- a comprehensive company health management - because your health is important to us

jobs.description: Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Reporting to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations, the role supports strategic priorities, transformational initiatives and cross-functional programs, helping to ensure the effective execution of operational and business objectives across the Eurozone and contributing to continued compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.The position supports the design, coordination, management and delivery of high-profile activities and strategic or transformational initiatives that require collaboration across multiple business functions. A central part of the Eurozone responsibilities is supporting regulatory readiness, coordinating compliance-related activities and helping ensure that relevant requirements, actions and dependencies are understood, tracked and progressed through the appropriate channels. Success in this role requires the ability to build strong partnerships, influence without direct authority and work effectively with stakeholders across Client Services, Product, Technology, Risk, Operations and other European and Global functions.Alongside these responsibilities, the role serves as a trusted advisor to an assigned portfolio of clients, helping them optimize operational performance, adopt new capabilities and maximize the value of their relationship with Visa.This role offers broad exposure across European and Global functions, regular interaction with experienced leaders and the opportunity to build capabilities in Client Success, regulatory readiness, strategic execution, transformation and stakeholder management. It is well suited to a high-performing professional who is ready to take ownership within a defined scope and contribute effectively from day one.Key Responsibilities:Client Success- Support and/or oversee the implementation of new Visa products the Client purchases by coordinating key Client and Visa teams to expedite implementation readiness activities and steer the client toward getting faster time to value and maximize adoption of deployed products. - Ensure Client operational goals and success metrics for their overall Visa product landscape are understood. - Build and sustain a client advocate status with key client stakeholders by proactively executing against forward-looking Client Success Plans, in alignment with the Account Team, to track client specific outcomes including a client’s adoption and performance of Visa products purchased. - Participate in the design and delivery of initiatives to improve client adoption of products and use of Visa’s self-tools. - Stay current with the latest payment processing trends, Visa solutions and technologies to provide a good Client experience and generate new sales leads as solutions to identified client pain points. - Establish working relationships with Client Services and other cross-functional subject matter experts to orchestrate consultation to resolve complex client issues and optimize client performance. - Support development of client education and training materials (including webinars) to communicate new Visa Rules, essential mandates, Visa Business Enhancement Releases and/or upcoming changes to ensure client readiness and service compliance.  - Support and/or lead periodic operational reviews with clients and Visa stakeholders. - Act, on an ad-hoc and as needed basis for applicable clients, as the escalation point for managing significant issues and major incident/crisis responses. - Proactively identify and drive opportunities to optimize client performance by monitoring client health and liaising with specialist Visa teams as needed. - Play the role of the overall Client Services main point of contact for colleagues and clients in your market.- Deliver Operational Resilience Support - to disseminate approved Corporate Communications’ messages to clients and maintain ongoing interaction with clients to meet their specific needs throughout a crisis event, coordinating and escalating queries where appropriate (as per agreed Crisis Management Plan). Eurozone Operations and Strategic Initiatives- Support the Head of Eurozone in progressing agreed strategic priorities and operational objectives.- Support the design, coordination, management and delivery of strategic and transformational initiatives, including high-profile activities with visibility across senior leadership.- Support regulatory readiness and the coordination of activities required to help maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams, plans, milestones, dependencies, risks and actions to support timely delivery of agreed outcomes.- Prepare clear analysis, insights, recommendations and management updates to support decision-making and stakeholder discussions.- Create and tailor a broad range of recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials for different stakeholder groups, including senior stakeholders, ensuring information is accurate, relevant and clearly communicated.- Support Eurozone operational readiness, governance and change activities while maintaining an appropriate level of confidentiality.- Build strong partnerships and collaborate closely with stakeholders across European and Global functions- Facilitate alignment between teams, clarify ownership and help resolve delivery challenges through structured coordination and follow-up- Represent relevant client and Client Success perspectives in cross-functional initiatives and change activities.- Translate complex regulatory, operational, technical and business topics into clear implications, actions and communications for different audiences.- Maintain effective action tracking and escalate material risks, issues, compliance matters or dependencies through the appropriate channels.Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.Qualifications- Relevant professional background, combined with a Bachelor’s degree or an advanced degree (e.g., Master’s, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).- Background in Client Success, Client Services, payments, operations, product, consulting, program management, risk, compliance or a related field.- Proven ability to coordinate and deliver cross-functional projects, workstreams or business initiatives in a matrix organization.- Previous work in a regulated environment, including support for regulatory, compliance, governance or operational readiness activities.- Strong track record of managing client or stakeholder relationships and translating business needs into clear actions and deliverables.- Strong partnership-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.- Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information and develop practical recommendations.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders at different levels and present information clearly.- Strong planning, organization and execution discipline, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies and deadlines.- Ability to work independently within an agreed scope, exercise sound judgment and seek guidance or escalate when appropriate.- Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.- Knowledge of payments, financial services, fintech, technology or consulting environments.- Exposure to strategic, transformational, change or operational improvement initiatives.- Proven ability to collaborate with regional and global stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.- Understanding of transaction processing, client operations, operational resilience, regulatory compliance or regulated operating environments.- Familiarity with regulatory governance, compliance monitoring, risk management or control frameworks.- Knowledge of project management, change management or process improvement approaches.- Ability to create and tailor management reports, dashboards, presentations and briefing materials for varied audiences, including senior stakeholders.- Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau is beneficial.- Fluent English and German required.Visa is an EEO EmployerQualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.Visa welcome and encourages application from persons with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).To strengthen our support for experimental research, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivatedElectronics Engineer (m/f/d)Your positionAs an Electronics Engineer, you will support cutting-edge experimental physics research by developing reliable, high-performance electronic systems in close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff.- Develop, design and implement analogue and digital electronic systems for experimental physics applications.- Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust electronic concepts, circuits and complete devices.- Design, assemble, commission and test printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic instruments, from initial concept through prototyping to deployment in the laboratory.- Diagnose, troubleshoot and optimise existing electronic systems and measurement equipment.- Develop firmware for microcontrollers and support the integration of hardware, firmware and software components.- Work closely with researchers and engineers to provide practical, user-oriented technical solutions for a broad range of experimental setups.- Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including circuit diagrams, PCB layouts, assembly instructions and test procedures.- As the role involves hands-on development, assembly, testing and support of laboratory equipment, regular on-site presence is an essential part of the position.Your background and skills- A university degree (Master’s degree or Diplom) in electrical engineering, electronics or a closely related field.- Sound practical experience in the development of analogue and digital electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout and the assembly, commissioning and testing of electronic devices.- Proficiency in common ECAD tools for schematic capture and PCB design, ideally including KiCad or Autodesk EAGLE, as well as familiarity with circuit-simulation tools.- Knowledge of firmware development for microcontrollers, ideally using C/C++. Experience in developing user software for the control, operation and monitoring of electronic devices is also desirable.- Experience with FPGA development and VHDL is an advantage. Familiarity with CAD systems for mechanical design is also desirable.- A strong understanding of the requirements and working practices of a diverse scientific and technical environment, combined with intercultural competence and effective communication skills.- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills.- Experience in laboratory electronics, measurement technology, scientific instrumentation or experimental physics is desirable.Our offer- A varied and responsible position in an international and interdisciplinary scientific environment, with the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative experimental research.- Close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff on challenging and diverse technical projects.- A family-friendly working environment with flexible working arrangements, in line with the practical requirements of laboratory-based work.- Opportunities for professional development and further training.- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the applicable public-sector collective agreement, depending on qualifications and professional experience.- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.- The opportunity to work in a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking research environment.- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticketYour applicationThe Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all background.The Max-Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.To apply please complete the online application form and attach you English CV and motivation letter as well as all relevant certificates latest 15th November, 2026.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact contact Dr. Friedjof Tellkamp by email at friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de) or Dr. Lars Tiemann at lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de (lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de) .Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter and the online application portal can be found on our website at: https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs (https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs)We look forward to your application.

jobs.description: Shape how SUSONITY creates, captures and sustains value worldwideAt SUSONITY, surfaces do more than look good — they deliver performance, differentiation and value. To strengthen our global commercial organization, we are looking for an experienced and influential Senior Pricing & Commercial Excellence Manager to take ownership of our commercial excellence agenda.This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of our global commercial organization. You will shape the frameworks, processes, systems and capabilities that enable our sales teams to perform at their best — while ensuring that SUSONITY captures the full value of its innovative products and solutions.You will act as the global catalyst for stronger pricing discipline, better commercial decision-making and consistently excellent execution across regions and markets. You will establish pricing as a strategic capability across SUSONITY by:- Developing and implementing a global pricing strategy aligned with business objectives, customer value and market dynamics.- Establishing pricing governance, principles, processes and approval frameworks across regions and businesses.- Driving value-based pricing, price differentiation and improved price realization.- Strengthening transparency and consistency in pricing decisions through robust data, analytics and performance management.- Partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance and regional leadership to embed pricing excellence into day-to-day commercial decisions.- Identifying opportunities to improve margins, commercial effectiveness and sustainable profitable growth.- Enhancing the use of pricing software and digital tools to enable fact-based, timely and scalable pricing decisions.Build and lead commercial excellenceBeyond pricing, you will lead the continued development of SUSONITY’s global commercial excellence platform:- Define and implement a global commercial excellence strategy that improves sales force effectiveness and delivers measurable business impact.- Optimize commercial infrastructure, including customer segmentation, lead management, opportunity tracking and campaign performance.- Establish meaningful KPIs, dashboards and performance routines that turn data into actionable commercial insight.- Drive the effective use and continuous improvement of Salesforce, pricing software and other commercial technologies.- Develop standardized frameworks, processes and tools that create alignment while allowing for relevant regional flexibility.- Strengthen launch excellence for new products and campaigns in close collaboration with Marketing, Product Management and regional teams.- Support post-merger integration by helping build a unified, scalable and high-performing commercial operating model.Lead people, influence globally and raise ambitionYou will lead a team of tool and process experts while orchestrating a broad global network of stakeholders across Commercial, Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance and other functions. Your role will be to create clarity, build momentum and turn strategic priorities into practical execution. You will challenge established ways of working, build strong partnerships and ensure that commercial excellence becomes a shared capability across the organization. What you bring- A university degree in Business Administration, Commercial Management, Sales, Finance or a related discipline.- Significant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, sales operations, commercial strategy or a comparable leadership function, ideally within a B2B or chemical industry environment.- Demonstrated success in developing and implementing pricing strategies, pricing governance, value-based pricing or commercial performance initiatives.- Strong understanding of the connection between pricing, customer value, sales effectiveness and profitable growth.- Experience leading teams, cross-functional programs and global stakeholder networks.- Strong command of CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, as well as pricing software and commercial analytics tools.- Excellent analytical and conceptual capabilities, combined with the ability to translate insights into clear decisions and practical action.- Proven project and change management skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives in a fast-moving, international environment.- Exceptional communication, influencing and negotiation skills, including the confidence to engage with senior stakeholders.- A pragmatic, entrepreneurial and collaborative leadership style.- Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage. Why join SUSONITY?This is an opportunity to shape a function that is strategically critical to SUSONITY’s future.You will have the mandate and visibility to build global pricing and commercial excellence capabilities from the ground up, influence how we go to market and help ensure that the value of our innovations is reflected in every commercial decision.At SUSONITY, you will work in a culture that combines scientific expertise, creative exploration and entrepreneurial drive. We empower our people to take ownership, challenge conventions and create meaningful impact across markets and industries.If you are ready to make pricing a true source of competitive advantage and to help build the commercial foundation of a fast-evolving global organization, we look forward to hearing from you.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
